nodes.text: Player King 在城堡大厅的长凳上躺下，佯装入睡。
在厄耳锡诺城堡，吉尔登斯特恩与罗森克兰茨决定分头监视哈姆雷特。
Marcellus was on the battlements.
Marcellus had seen a ghost at the battlements.
At Elsinore, the First Player recited the Pyrrhus/Hecuba speech beginning 'The rugged Pyrrhus...'.
The First Player's recitation of the Pyrrhus/Hecuba speech at Elsinore was delivered before King Claudius, Prince Hamlet, Rosencrantz, Guildenstern, Ophelia, and the royal court.
Laertes, while in France, composes a letter addressed to his father Polonius.
在城堡大厅，卢西安纳斯向霍拉旭提议在戏中安排以毒药毒死伶王侄儿的一幕，借此刺探伶王的反应。
在城堡大厅，Lucianus准备立刻排练首场新戏。
在厄耳锡诺城堡的王后寝宫，波洛涅斯的尸体被发现。
国王克劳狄斯下令封锁厄耳锡诺城堡并彻查杀害波洛涅斯的凶手。
发现波洛涅斯尸体后，王后格特鲁德陷入沉默。
哈姆雷特暂未离开厄耳锡诺城堡王后寝宫的案发现场。
奥菲莉亚在厄耳锡诺城堡的大厅听闻父亲波洛涅斯死讯后晕厥。
霍拉旭在城堡大厅向国王与群臣报告，称朝中风雨多端。
霍拉旭在城堡大厅向国王与群臣劝告，务必慎察近臣，勿轻信浮词。
霍拉旭在城堡大厅向国王与群臣建议以公正与节制安抚民心，并表示愿意详陈他所见。
吉尔登斯特恩与罗森克兰茨轮流跟踪哈姆雷特在走廊与城堡露台的行踪。
在厄耳锡诺城堡，奥菲莉亚将假意接近哈姆雷特以试探他的举止和精神状态。
吉尔登斯特恩与罗森克兰茨暗中向波洛涅斯打听哈姆雷特的近况。
吉尔登斯特恩与罗森克兰茨规定凡见哈姆雷特自言自语、激烈情绪或反常举动即向国王克劳狄斯汇报。
Laertes, while in France, composes a letter addressed to his sister Ophelia.
Laertes dispatches a swift messenger from France to Elsinore to ask whether Polonius requires Laertes's immediate return.
Marcellus saw a ghost on the battlements of Elsinore.
Barnardo saw a ghost on the battlements of Elsinore.
At Elsinore, the Prologue recited the prologue for the play-within-a-play.
The troupe of players began the performance of that play at Elsinore.
In Elsinore's great hall, the Prologue asked the audience to be seated and to keep silent.
在厄耳锡诺，吉尔登斯特恩和罗森克兰茨分配监视哈姆雷特的职责：罗森克兰茨负责盯守城堡的露台与外廊
在城堡大厅，Lucianus表示愿意代为引荐伶后上台发言。
在城堡大厅，Lucianus指示霍拉旭立即召集全部演员。
在城堡大厅，Lucianus指示霍拉旭分配演员分别扮演被害的侄儿、下毒者与旁观者。
在城堡大厅，Lucianus指示舞台工作人员用无害着色剂在舞台上模拟毒药。
在城堡大厅，Lucianus要求在受害者倒地处留白三秒以观察剧团首席演员的反应。
在城堡大厅，伶王允准王后向群臣发表讲话，但要求先听霍拉旭向众人详陈其见。
在厄耳锡诺城堡，国王克劳狄斯命令罗森克兰茨与吉尔登斯特恩靠近哈姆雷特并密切监视哈姆雷特的神色与
在厄耳锡诺城堡，国王克劳狄斯指示第一伶人演出一段包含“国王被暗害”桥段的戏，以试探哈姆雷特的反应。
在王后寝宫，哈姆雷特多次向王后格特鲁德质问，追问克劳狄乌斯是否谋害国王并隐瞒真相。
王后格特鲁德再次否认自己与克劳狄乌斯合谋谋害国王。
The stately figure in full armour seemed to fade when the bell tolled at Elsinore.
Marcellus asked Horatio to come to the battlements of Elsinore to see the stately figure.
在厄耳锡诺城堡，罗森克兰茨被分配负责监视哈姆雷特的走廊与大厅。
在厄耳锡诺城堡，吉尔登斯特恩被分配负责监视哈姆雷特的露台与外廊。
罗森克兰茨、吉尔登斯特恩与奥菲莉亚约定若见哈姆雷特有异常举止立即向国王克劳狄斯报告。
In Elsinore's great hall, Ophelia thanked the Prologue for the introduction and promised to remain seated and watch quietly.
At the battlements, Barnardo told Marcellus that Barnardo would fetch Horatio.
At the battlements of Elsinore, Barnardo ordered Marcellus to stay and keep watch.
面对哈姆雷特的质问，王后格特鲁德保持沉默。
王后格特鲁德再次否认知道波洛涅斯的尸体出现在王后寝宫。
在城堡大厅，Lucianus向霍拉旭说明这个幕景是一个艺术设想。
在城堡大厅，Lucianus告诉霍拉旭该幕景的资助来自Lucianus私人资金。
在城堡大厅，Lucianus向霍拉旭承诺将原本的受害者改为虚构人物。
在城堡大厅，Lucianus向霍拉旭承诺演出将全部采用无害且象征性的道具与表演。
在城堡大厅，Lucianus请霍拉旭担任該幕景的舞台安全与合规监督。
在城堡大厅，Lucianus询问霍拉旭是否愿意参与该幕景，或将该幕景的事宜禀报伶王。
In the castle hall, Horatio told the Player King that Lucianus planned to stage a scene in the play in which the Player King's nephew would be poisoned.
Horatio told the Player King that Lucianus said the purpose of the poisoning scene was to test the Player King's reaction.
Horatio told the Player King that Horatio refused to participate in any staging that would depict the poisoning of the Player King's nephew.
Horatio suggested to the Player King changing the supposed victim in the play to a fictional character instead of the Player King's nephew.
Horatio suggested to the Player King substituting a harmless prop for any poisonous substance in the play.
Horatio suggested to the Player King investigating who proposed and who funded Lucianus's plan to stage a poisoning scene in the play.
在厄耳锡诺城堡，第一伶人向国王克劳狄斯报告，诸位演员已就位并将按原计划上演包含“国王被暗害”桥段的戏剧。
在厄耳锡诺城堡，第一伶人向国王克劳狄斯说明，若哈姆雷特在观剧时有明显反应，演员们会立即向克劳狄斯禀报
At Elsinore, the Prologue stated that Rosencrantz and Guildenstern would observe Prince Hamlet during the performance.
At Elsinore, the First Player told Ophelia to remain attentive to Prince Hamlet and to the performance.
At Elsinore, the First Player told Ophelia that the actors were ready.
在王后寝宫，哈姆雷特要求王后格特鲁德以死者之名发誓。
在王后寝宫，哈姆雷特要求格特鲁德发誓说明在哈姆雷特的父亲、已故国王死前她是否见过克劳狄乌斯接触那位父王
Laertes arranges funds and secures a swift ship and passage from France, readies baggage and horses so he can depart for Elsinore at short notice.
在城堡大厅，Player King命令霍拉旭逐条陈述霍拉旭所怀疑之人、霍拉旭所见之异状与可资核验的缘由。
在城堡大厅，Player King命令卢西安纳斯如无解释则暂且缄默，不得发言。
在城堡大厅，Player King嘱咐Player Queen在发表意见时措辞以安抚民心、并以维护朝内和解为重。
In the great hall, Lucianus told the King that Lucianus had proposed and privately funded an inserted theatrical scene to test the King's reaction.
In the great_hall, Lucianus requested leave to proceed with a single supervised rehearsal under Horatio's oversight.
In the great hall, Lucianus told the King that Lucianus had adopted Horatio's safeguard of making the staged victim a fictional character.
In the great hall, Lucianus told the King that Lucianus had adopted Horatio's safeguard of using harmless symbolic effects such as colored liquid, narration, or pantomime instead of real poisoning.
In the castle hall, the Player King allowed Lucianus to stage the disputed scene only under specified conditions.
In Elsinore's great hall, King Claudius ordered the court play to proceed as planned.
King Claudius demanded that the play's murder scene be performed exactly and convincingly to draw out Prince Hamlet.
King Claudius instructed Rosencrantz and Guildenstern to report any notable reaction from Hamlet immediately.
At Elsinore, King Claudius ordered attendants to protect Queen Gertrude.

At Elsinore, Guildenstern asked Rosencrantz to confirm that Rosencrantz had begun Rosencrantz's hour of watch on the corridors and in the great hall and to report the exact start time of Rosencrantz's hour.
At Elsinore, Guildenstern asked Ophelia to approach Hamlet discreetly and to tell Guildenstern when Ophelia could act, preferably during the play or during a quiet moment.
At Elsinore, the Prologue acknowledged the First Player's instructions about the forthcoming performance.
At Elsinore, the Prologue stated that attendants would stand ready to protect Queen Gertrude.
In the castle hall, the Player King required that the on-stage 'victim' in Lucianus's scene must be a fictional character.
In the castle hall, the Player King forbade the use of real poison or any dangerous prop in Lucianus's scene.
In the great_hall, the King appointed Horatio (Lord Horatio) as the stage safety and compliance supervisor for rehearsals of Lucianus's proposed poisoning scene.

In the castle hall, the Player King required Horatio to verify the safety measures for Lucianus's rehearsal and then state Horatio's concerns and the safety protocols to the court before any performance.
Queen Gertrude swore by King Hamlet's memory that she had never seen Claudius touch King Hamlet's medicines.
Queen Gertrude told Hamlet that she did not know that Polonius's body had been placed in the queen's closet.
At Elsinore, Fortinbras ordered Marcellus to bring the muster rolls to Fortinbras.
At Elsinore, Fortinbras ordered Marcellus to summon the captains.
At Elsinore, Fortinbras ordered Marcellus to fetch a wagon of grain.
At Elsinore, Fortinbras ordered Marcellus to lead Fortinbras to the Great Hall.
At Elsinore's Great Hall, Fortinbras was to inventory the arms after Marcellus led him there.
At Elsinore's Great Hall, Fortinbras was to gather the grain after Marcellus led him there.
In the queen's closet, Hamlet told Queen Gertrude that King Hamlet's ghost said King Hamlet had been murdered.
Hamlet told Queen Gertrude that King Hamlet's ghost said poison had been poured into King Hamlet's ear.
Hamlet told Queen Gertrude that King Hamlet's ghost named Claudius as King Hamlet's murderer.
Queen Gertrude offered to help Hamlet investigate King Hamlet's murder if Hamlet produced evidence.
In the great_hall, the King authorized a single supervised rehearsal of Lucianus's proposed poisoning scene provided the on-stage victim is a clearly fictional character.
In the great_hall, the King prohibited any public rehearsals of Lucianus's proposed poisoning scene until the scene's funding sources and intent are fully disclosed.
The Queen requires Lucianus to disclose the scene's sponsors in writing; if Lucianus does not disclose sponsors, the scene shall remain forbidden.
In the great_hall, the Queen forbade Lucianus from staging the poisoning scene as he originally proposed.
Lucianus agreed to convert his proposed poisoning scene into a harmless, symbolic staging.
Lucianus claimed that the funding for his proposed poisoning scene was his private initiative.
The Queen authorizes Horatio to supervise a safe, symbolic rewrite of Lucianus's scene that stages the poisoning of the king's nephew.
The Queen authorizes Horatio to investigate the funding and authorship of Lucianus's scene that stages the poisoning of the king's nephew.
The Queen orders rehearsals of Lucianus's scene to be confined to a secure, supervised chamber and orders that all props used be harmless.
In the queen's closet, Queen Gertrude ordered the chamberlain to be summoned.
In the queen's closet, Queen Gertrude ordered the steward to be summoned.
Queen Gertrude ordered any servants who held keys to King Hamlet's chamber to be summoned to appear at court.
In the queen's closet, Queen Gertrude ordered the palace guards to secure the palace.
Queen Gertrude instructed the castle guards to preserve any physical evidence related to King Hamlet's death.
In the great hall, Lucianus presented Horatio with a written disclosure that named Lucianus as sole sponsor and financier and listed collaborators and performers.
In Elsinore's great hall, the Prologue confirmed that the actors were in position.
At Elsinore, the stage lights were dimmed for the play-within-a-play.
At Elsinore, the actors began the dumb-show portion of the play-within-a-play.
At Elsinore, Rosencrantz and Guildenstern watched Prince Hamlet during the play-within-a-play.
At Elsinore, attendants stood ready to protect Queen Gertrude during the performance.
Queen Gertrude instructed the castle guards to secure Elsinore Castle following King Hamlet's death.
In the great hall, Lucianus placed harmless, clearly labeled stage props before Horatio, including a bottle labeled "stage dye", ribbon and colored cloth, pantomime cues, and the rehearsal script.
Palace officers were present in the great hall to witness the presentation and to enforce safety during the rehearsal.
At Elsinore Castle at tick 35, Rosencrantz began an hour of watching the corridors and the great hall.
At Elsinore Castle at tick 35, Rosencrantz told Guildenstern that Rosencrantz would search for Hamlet and would report any notable reactions to the king.
In the great_hall, Lucianus pledged to produce written disclosures naming Lucianus as sponsor.
In the great_hall, Lucianus pledged that the written disclosures would list collaborators and actors.
In the great_hall, Lucianus pledged to submit a detailed safety plan.
In the great_hall, Lucianus accepted the Crown's conditions.
